description: Fill a standard template. Default output on MCP: content[0] = the bilingual document text, content[1] = short summary; structuredContent = metadata (status, warnings, 1-hour DOCX/PDF download links with a random id; the fill data is kept encrypted on the server for 1 hour, never in the URL); request formats docx/pdf for base64. Optional auction_id (SUB-... or BOE-B-...) prefills empty fields from public BOE data (read only, nothing is submitted); it must match fields.auction_id / fields.boe_announcement_id if those are given (else error auction_id_conflict). Incomplete fills come back with status draft_incomplete and a DRAFT / DO NOT SIGN watermark. No case assessment, no legal advice; the notary drafts the final deed. Partner-only templates need the partner key.

auction_id.description: Optional SUB-... or BOE-B-... to prefill from public data.

fields.description: Field values; principals is an array of {name, kind natural|legal, id_type, id_number, nationality (ISO alpha-2, natural persons), country (ISO alpha-2, country of incorporation) and registry (companies), address, share_percent, signatory, signatory_basis}.

formats.description: MCP default [text, links]. docx/pdf add base64 files. REST default [text, docx, pdf, links].

lang.description: Second language next to the base language: en (default), de, it, fr (as listed in the template).

template_id.description: Template id from list_templates or quote_action, e.g. es_auction_poa_v2.

name: fill_template
